summary_en: 2,200,000 shares (2.4% of S/O) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-07-14 at ¥910/share closing price, up to ¥2.002B total. Settlement 2026-07-14. Deducted from broader 3,000,000-share (3.3% S/O) program authorized 2026-07-13 for period 2026-07-14 to 2026-09-30.
title_en: Notice of acquisition of treasury shares via off-hours transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: Curves Holdings announced on 2026-07-13 an immediate block acquisition of 2,200,000 shares via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-07-14, using the previous trading day's closing price of ¥910/share, for a total expenditure not to exceed ¥2.002 billion. This block purchase is deducted from the broader 3,000,000-share (3.3% of S/O) buyback program authorized by the board on the same date for the period 2026-07-14 to 2026-09-30. The block represents 2.4% of shares outstanding (ex-treasury). Results will be disclosed after the 08:45 JST settlement on 2026-07-14. The stated rationale is to improve capital efficiency and enhance enterprise value as part of the group's 2030–2035 medium-term vision, with acquired shares potentially used for warrant exercises or cancellation.
